slices.name: ws01-22-theme-scope
slices.brief:
WS01 slice 22 of 32 (checkpoint D, the design system; slices 20 to 32; its draft PR is #108). Branch redesign/ws01-design-system, HEAD 06f8dd8 (slice 21); the base for diffs is main. Checkpoints A, B and C are merged to main and live. Read first: REDESIGN_STATUS.md (Ordering rules, the acceptance table, Decisions, Deviations, Follow-ups, and step 21), docs/redesign/REDESIGN_SPEC.md section 1 (the decided look, and the Heritage pages row: the full heritage scope on six pages, base inside heritage as the one permitted nesting, header and footer always base) and section WS01 (the heritage tokens and the nesting rule, the ThemeScope and live.css file notes, AC8 no layout shift on a scope switch, AC11 the heritage font chunk and CLS, AC12 the route-to-scope map, and the themeScopes.test.ts line), the Looks boards for exact values where the brief leaves them to the boards: docs/redesign/lca-redesign-boards/boards/Looks-7-Broadcast-Tile.dc.html (Broadcast is the live scope; its type line names the live fonts) and Looks-6-Scholastic-Tile.dc.html (the hue tiles and their words), src/index.css (the data-theme token blocks from slice 21), src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx (the route list and the a11y-only fixture route), src/lib/features.ts, src/pages/fixtures/ScopeFixturePage.tsx, src/components/StatusBadge.tsx, src/components/ui/button.tsx and input.tsx, test/unit/tokens.test.ts (how index.css is parsed), test/unit/appearance-control.test.tsx (the jsdom component test convention), and the browser test harness (playwright.config.ts, test/a11y/global-setup.ts, support.ts, baseline.ts, baseline.json, builds.spec.ts, tokens.spec.ts) so the new test/a11y/scope-switch.spec.ts follows its conventions and the flag-off baseline comparison stays green. The lead's notes win over this brief and the manifest where they differ: <scratchpad>/ws01-lead-notes.md. The manifest entry (order 22) is in <scratchpad>/ws01-manifest.json. node_modules is installed; nothing ever runs against a remote database or the Cloudflare account; agents never commit, stash, reset or check out anything; the working tree is the only copy.

Environment facts for this container: the pinned Playwright expects a Chromium build the container does not have, so every npm run test:a11y here runs as PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium npm run test:a11y (the config reads that variable); never run playwright install; WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false on every wrangler command; localhost is exempt from the outbound proxy, so the a11y servers on 127.0.0.1 work. Dependencies are exact-pinned (no caret) at versions at least two weeks old, with package-lock.json updated by npm install. The branch tip is aaa001b, one commit after 06f8dd8 that changes only .claude/workflows/build-slice.js; the local main ref in this container is 4c1a466 and does not carry the checkpoint merges, so a diff against the local main shows far more than this slice: take this slice's own changes as the working tree against 06f8dd8.

Build exactly this. Add the scope mechanism every themed area uses. src/components/ThemeScope.tsx takes a scope prop: 'base', 'heritage', 'live' or 'scholastic'. It renders a wrapper with data-theme and display: contents where layout must not change, where base renders data-theme="" as the reset, and lazily imports the scope's font CSS: src/styles/themes/live.css now, heritage.css in slice 30, and scholastic fonts in WS11. Nesting rules from the brief: one level only, base inside heritage is the one permitted nesting, and heritage never renders inside live. ThemeScope warns in development and the unit test asserts the rule. live.css imports only @fontsource/barlow-condensed and @fontsource/barlow (exact-pinned); JetBrains Mono is added only if the Looks-7 tile requires it. src/lib/themeScopes.ts exports routeScope(pathname): admin, workspace, manage, dashboard, account and board inbox routes are always base, and the heritage set (/about, /governance/board, /governance/bylaws, /governance/minutes, /meeting, /champions) resolves to heritage. The ScopeFixturePage from slice 20 renders a fixture container per scope, including the scholastic hue tiles with their words. Token blocks already live in index.css (slice 21), so a scope switch never flashes base colours. Nothing renders ThemeScope outside the fixture page in this slice.

Verify items from the manifest, each to be re-checked against the tree as it is now (the earlier finding follows): Live fonts: @fontsource/barlow-condensed and @fontsource/barlow 5.3.0 exist on npm (re-checked: both 5.3.0, published July 19, 2026, so older than two weeks; neither is installed yet: node_modules/@fontsource holds only instrument-serif and node_modules/@fontsource-variable holds geist and geist-mono). The Looks-7 tile's type line reads 'Barlow Condensed + Barlow + JetBrains Mono, with Big Shoulders Display for round banners only' and lists JetBrains Mono 400/500/700 (@fontsource/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0 exists), while slice 21's acceptance made Geist Mono the only mono face; decide whether the tile requires JetBrains Mono and record the decision either way. Big Shoulders Display is not in this slice. Heritage routes: App.tsx has lazy routes /meeting, /about, /governance/board, /champions, /governance/bylaws and /governance/minutes (re-checked: src/App.tsx lines 100, 101, 105, 106, 108 and 111). Three redirect paths lead into that set: /governance to /governance/board (line 104), /state-champions to /champions (line 107) and /governance/rules to /governance/bylaws (line 110); the heritage set stays exactly the six pages, so say what routeScope returns for the redirects. The always-base routes in App.tsx today are /dashboard (113), /account/security (116), /manage/club (117), /board/inbox (124), /workspace (126), /admin, /admin/:section, /admin/clubs/:id and /admin/tournaments/:id (130 to 133); tournament management lives under /admin/tournaments/:id and there is no /manage/tournaments route. Further differences between the manifest's assumptions and the tree: Token blocks: src/index.css holds them, but every scope selector sits under the new look, :root[data-look="new"] [data-theme="live"] (line 316), [data-theme="scholastic"] (359), [data-theme="heritage"] (406) and the heritage dark block (422), and data-theme="" is part of the base selectors (244 and 282). --gold-ink is #705718 in heritage light (415) and #866a1e in base light (257), but #c8a94a in base dark (294) and heritage dark (431), so themeScopes.test.ts reads the light blocks under data-look=new, and with newLook off a scope switch changes no token at all; AC8's colour change can only be shown on the a11y-on build. ScopeFixturePage: src/pages/fixtures/ScopeFixturePage.tsx exists and is reached only in the a11y build (App.tsx lines 51 to 52 and 135 to 136), but it renders one container per URL, /__fixtures/:name with name base, heritage, scholastic or live, setting data-theme directly from FIXTURE_SCOPES (line 60) rather than through ThemeScope; it has no way to switch data-theme in place (AC8's switch is made either by the test or by a control added to the fixture, recorded either way), no scholastic hue tiles (the tokens --gold-tile, --coral, --coral-tile, --mint, --mint-tile, --sky, --sky-tile, --grape and --grape-tile already exist in the scholastic block), and its header comment (lines 13 to 15) still says every name renders in the base look. Its StatusBadge uses the legacy tone and on classes with fixed Tailwind colours, not the status tokens, so its colour does not follow the scope; measure AC8's colour change on token-backed elements and its box stability on Button, Input and StatusBadge. New files: src/components/ThemeScope.tsx, src/styles/themes/live.css (the src/styles folder does not exist yet), src/lib/themeScopes.ts, test/unit/themeScopes.test.ts, test/unit/theme-scope.test.tsx and test/a11y/scope-switch.spec.ts do not exist yet. Flags: src/lib/features.ts also defines themeHeritage and themeScholastic (both false); the manifest names only newLook, and nothing renders ThemeScope outside the fixture page in this slice, so neither is wired here. Risks: a lazily loaded font can cause a layout shift on first switch; the AC8 test measures after fonts are ready and the heritage CLS is measured separately (slice 31).

Gate before reporting: npm run lint (baseline 34 errors and 13 warnings, measured on this tree; the error total never rises and every error in a touched file is fixed; report before and after), npm run build, npm run typecheck:functions, npm run check:bundle, npm run test:all (unit 2141 in 89 files and integration 790 in 58 files before this slice; report the counts), and then PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium npm run test:a11y end to end in this container with its output quoted (both builds, the flag-off baseline compared and unchanged, the new scope-switch.spec.ts results on both projects; 91 passed and 18 skipped before this slice). test/a11y/baseline.json must not be rewritten: with newLook off nothing visible changes, and a baseline difference is a defect in the slice. If an integration file fails to load as a whole on the first run, rerun that file alone once before treating it as real. Standing rules: no AI references anywhere, in code, code comments, docs or commit text; read the real file before changing it; match repo conventions; WCAG 2.2 AA; plain language ('US Chess', a weekday on every date, '7:00 PM'); no em dashes in anything you write; fixtures contain nothing real; new packages exact-pinned. The recorder updates REDESIGN_STATUS.md (a step 22 block; the acceptance table row this slice proves, added in the table's own pattern if none fits; decisions; deviations; each resolved verify item; the counts) and, if the slice deviates from the brief, the step 22 sentence in the WS01 deviations list of docs/redesign/REDESIGN_SPEC.md, and drafts the commit text into <scratchpad>/slice22-commit.txt: a subject under 72 characters and plain prose, no attribution or co-author lines, no session links, no em dashes. The step records, the acceptance table and Decisions must not use the words slice, builder, scout, planner, recorder, manifest, subagent, workflow or the phrase the lead.
files: docs/redesign/REDESIGN_SPEC.md (the step 22 deviation sentence, only if needed)
acceptance: AC8: switching data-theme among base, live, scholastic and heritage on the fixture container changes token colours, while the bounding boxes of Button, Input and StatusBadge do not move (layout-shift observer reports 0)
themeScopes.test.ts: --gold-ink resolves to #705718 inside heritage and #866a1e in base (parsed from index.css); the heritage route set is exactly the six pages
theme-scope.test.tsx: base inside heritage is allowed; heritage inside live and any other nesting is reported
live.css is fetched only when a live scope renders (network check on the fixture page)
REDESIGN_STATUS.md records this slice's acceptance row, any deviation and each resolved verify item
